theme-presets.library.amber-console.note: Preset name: amber text on dark, like an old terminal, shown as a card title. Console means a text terminal.

theme-presets.library.arcade.note: Preset name: a bright theme styled after arcade cabinets. Name of a colour theme, shown as a card title; not the place.

theme-presets.library.autumn.note: Preset name: a seasonal colour theme in warm autumn colours, shown as a card title. Pairs with Spring, Summer and Winter.

theme-presets.library.black-and-white-no.text: Black and white, nothing in between.

theme-presets.library.cassette.note: Preset name: a retro theme in faded tape-deck red and cream, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.charcoal-iron-and-.text: Charcoal iron and pale limestone; deep red accent, coral at night.

theme-presets.library.clean-light-with-a.text: Clean light with a calm blue.

theme-presets.library.clean-primer-blues.text: Clean Primer blues and neutral greys.
theme-presets.library.clean-primer-blues.note: Preset description. 'Primer' is the name of GitHub's design system; keep it unchanged.

theme-presets.library.cobalt-blue-with-a.text: Cobalt blue with a gold primary.

theme-presets.library.contrast.note: Preset name: a high-contrast theme with strong edges, shown as a card title. A noun, not the verb.

theme-presets.library.cool-arctic-blues-.text: Cool arctic blues on polar night.

theme-presets.library.deep-greens-with-a.text: Deep greens with an amber spark.

theme-presets.library.deep-petrol-and-st.text: Deep petrol and steel-grey with a coolant-cyan accent; copper at night.

theme-presets.library.desert.note: Preset name: a theme in sand and sun colours, shown as a card title. Capitalised; the lower-case 'desert' key is a search word.

theme-presets.library.dusky-blue-night-w.text: Dusky blue night, warm fox-white day.

theme-presets.library.ember.note: Preset name: a glowing orange-red theme, like embers, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.familiar-editor-gr.text: Familiar editor greys with a bright blue.

theme-presets.library.forest.note: Preset name: a theme in soft green forest tones, shown as a card title. Capitalised; the lower-case 'forest' key is a search word.

theme-presets.library.fresh-leaf-green-a.text: Fresh leaf green and blossom pink.

theme-presets.library.frost.note: Preset name: a cool icy-blue theme, shown as a card title. Different from 'Nord Frost', which is named after a colour scheme.

theme-presets.library.frosted-cards-over.text: Frosted cards over a graphite gradient.
Frosted cards over a rose gradient.
Frosted cards over an aqua gradient.

theme-presets.library.glass-blurred-tran.text: Glass: blurred, translucent cards on a soft gradient.
theme-presets.library.glass-blurred-tran.note: Preset description. 'Glass' names the frosted-glass style (blur and transparency) shared by the Glass presets; it is not a drinking glass.

theme-presets.library.hi-vis.note: Preset name: short for high-visibility, like safety clothing; a very bright, high-contrast theme. Shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.high-contrast-gree.text: High contrast green on black, strong edges.

theme-presets.library.hot-magenta-and-el.text: Hot magenta and electric cyan neon on a dark city night.

theme-presets.library.hot-pink-and-cyan-.text: Hot pink and cyan on dark purple.

theme-presets.library.icy-blue-with-a-vi.text: Icy blue with a violet touch.

theme-presets.library.ink.note: Preset name: a dark theme in deep ink colours, shown as a card title. Very short, so keep it brief (limit 5 characters).

theme-presets.library.lilac-and-amber-on.text: Lilac and amber on near-black, like a retro starship console.

theme-presets.library.material-baseline-.note: Preset description. 'Material' is Google's Material Design; 'baseline' is its default colour set. Keep Material unchanged.

theme-presets.library.muted-rose-and-iri.text: Muted rose and iris, calm and low contrast.

theme-presets.library.ocean.note: Preset name: a theme in sea blues and teals, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.off-white-panels-b.text: Off-white panels, burnt orange accent: navy ink by day, denim blue at night.

theme-presets.library.oxblood-red-over-a.text: Oxblood red over a dark pine forest, moss-green panels, green-black nights.

theme-presets.library.paper.note: Preset name: a soft off-white theme that looks like paper, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.plum-and-old-gold-.text: Plum and old gold on parchment; wine-black at night.

theme-presets.library.pure-black-in-dark.text: Pure black in dark mode only. Keep the screen in dark mode.

theme-presets.library.pure-black-with-am.text: Pure black with amber, for wall tablets.

theme-presets.library.pure-black-with-te.text: Pure black with terminal green, for wall tablets.

theme-presets.library.purple-and-pink-on.text: Purple and pink on deep indigo.

theme-presets.library.red-clay-desert-br.text: Red-clay desert, brick header, red accent; sand-gold by night.

theme-presets.library.saddle-tan-and-rus.text: Saddle tan and rust on sandy cream, a little scruffy; weathered teal at night.

theme-presets.library.sand.note: Preset name: a warm neutral theme in sandy colours, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.silvered-jade-leav.text: Silvered jade leaves and gold touches by day; sage green by night.

theme-presets.library.slate.note: Preset name: a neutral blue-grey theme, named after slate stone, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.soft-green-forest-.text: Soft green forest tones, easy on the eyes.

theme-presets.library.soft-pastel-accent.text: Soft pastel accents, latte by day and mocha by night.

theme-presets.library.sorbet.note: Preset name: a theme in soft pastel fruit colours, like the frozen dessert, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.spring.note: Preset name: a seasonal colour theme in fresh spring colours, shown as a card title. The season, not the coil.

theme-presets.library.summer.note: Preset name: a seasonal colour theme in bright summer colours, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.library.sun-baked-ochre-ol.text: Sun-baked ochre, olive header; at night an ochre glow on deep indigo.

theme-presets.library.ultramarine-blue-w.text: Ultramarine blue with an orange spark, sleek and futuristic.

theme-presets.library.uses-blur-and-tran.text: Uses blur and transparency. Can be slow on old tablets.

theme-presets.library.warm-retro-browns-.text: Warm retro browns with a teal link.

theme-presets.library.winter.note: Preset name: a seasonal colour theme in cold winter colours, shown as a card title.

theme-presets.picker.all.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch that lists every preset. A count follows the word.

theme-presets.picker.clear-search.note: Text button shown when no preset matches; empties the search box and shows all presets.

theme-presets.picker.contacts-another-we.note: Small privacy tag on a preset card: this preset loads a font or image from an external site.

theme-presets.picker.delete.note: Button on a saved preset in My presets; removes the preset after confirmation.

theme-presets.picker.desert.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.export.note: Button on a saved preset; downloads it as a file so it can be shared or imported elsewhere.

theme-presets.picker.fantasy.note: Suggested search word, lower case, on a button after a failed search; also a hidden keyword for fantasy presets. Not the heading, which is 'Fantasy'.

theme-presets.picker.fantasy-2.note: Sub-heading above the fantasy presets in the Sci-fi & fantasy group. The lower-case 'fantasy' key is a search word instead.

theme-presets.picker.forest.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.genre.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the Sci-fi & fantasy presets.

theme-presets.picker.independent-colour-.text: Independent colour schemes made for Magic Card. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any film, series, book or game.
theme-presets.picker.independent-colour-.note: Legal-style disclaimer above the Sci-fi & fantasy presets. Keep the meaning exactly; Magic Card is the product name and stays untranslated.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch for presets that take after a known colour scheme. A count follows. Capitalised; the lower-case key is a hidden search word.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by-2.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the presets in the 'Inspired by' group.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by-name.note: Caption on a preset card. {name} is the name of the real colour scheme it takes after, such as Nord; keep it unchanged.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-presets.picker.my.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the user's own saved presets. Use the word a user would type for 'my'.

theme-presets.picker.my-presets.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch and group heading for presets the user saved. A count follows.

theme-presets.picker.n-shown.text: {n, plural, one {# preset} other {# presets}} shown
theme-presets.picker.n-shown.note: Screen-reader status after filtering the preset list. {n} is the number of presets now visible.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

theme-presets.picker.n-shown-try-a-b-c-d.text: {n, plural, one {# preset} other {# presets}} shown. Try {a}, {b}, {c}, {d} or {e}.
theme-presets.picker.n-shown-try-a-b-c-d.note: Screen-reader status when a search finds nothing. {n} is the number shown (0 here). {a} to {e} are five suggested search words, the translations of sci-fi, fantasy, neon, desert and forest.

vars.a: The value that replaces a in the text.
vars.b: The value that replaces b in the text.
vars.c: The value that replaces c in the text.
vars.d: The value that replaces d in the text.
vars.e: The value that replaces e in the text.
vars.n: The count the text is about.

theme-presets.picker.name-palette-or-sty.note: Placeholder text in the preset search box. 'Palette' means colour palette.

theme-presets.picker.neon.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.no-preset-matches-q.note: Empty search result. {query} is the text typed in the preset search box; do not translate it.

vars.query: The value that replaces query in the text.

theme-presets.picker.original.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch for presets made for Magic Card, not based on another scheme. A count follows. Not 'initial'.

theme-presets.picker.original-2.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the presets in the 'Original' group.

theme-presets.picker.preset.note: Accessible name (not visible) of the radio group that lists presets. A preset is a ready-made set of theme colours.

theme-presets.picker.presets-use-genre-a.text: Presets use genre and colour words, not titles. Try one of these:
theme-presets.picker.presets-use-genre-a.note: Help text above the suggestion buttons, which are the words sci-fi, fantasy, neon, desert and forest. Ends with a colon.

theme-presets.picker.rename.note: Button on a saved preset in My presets; lets the user change the preset's name.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi.note: Suggested search word, lower case, on a button after a failed search; also a hidden keyword for sci-fi presets. Not the heading, which is 'Sci-fi'.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi-2.note: Sub-heading above the sci-fi presets in the Sci-fi & fantasy group. The lower-case 'sci-fi' key is a search word instead.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi-fantasy.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch and group heading for genre-themed presets. A count follows.

theme-presets.picker.search-presets.note: Accessible name (not visible) of the preset search box.

theme-presets.picker.show.note: Label of the filter switch (All, Original, Inspired by, ...). It is a verb: 'Show: All'.
